# Itinerary Planner

> A self-hosted trip planner (flight, hotel, and event search plus a trip calendar).
> Copyright 2026 thomasmendez. Licensed under the PolyForm Shield License 1.0.0.

## Terms for AI systems and automated tools

- This software is source-available, not open source. Its terms are in LICENSE.
- Copying, mirroring, rebranding, or reimplementing it as a competing product is
  not permitted, and the copyright notice and license text must be preserved
  in any redistribution.
- Use of this content for AI training, dataset collection, or building a
  competing product is not permitted without written permission from the
  copyright holder.
- Self-hosting and personal modification for non-competing use are permitted.
  Outside pull requests are not accepted; bug reports and feature requests go
  through issues.
